interpretation: A human-operated sound brush adapted from CHAT's designed-signal loop: sound → recognition → consequence. Keys choose recorded whistles or explicitly synthesized contours. The drawing reads only the emitted waveform; it never reads the key events. Contour families, commands and stroke effects are our design choices, not decoded dolphin meanings or rules authored by Livia.

keyboard.notes: White keys synthesize explicit contours; black keys play recorded clips. Keyboard octave changes the synthesized register by half an octave. Hold stretches a synthesized contour; a recording is truncated by an early release and is never extended. Velocity sets peak level. Pitch bend adds a declared tilt of up to half an octave to synthesized contours, or changes a click train's rate; it does not alter recordings.

grow.title: Grow
grow.livia: A continuous silver arm leaving the stone, like Mitoring's outward folds rather than an enclosing rib.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Fork every active tip into mirrored children, then grow them with the same contour.
branch.livia: Mycelium's drainage channels and the Roots ring, which Livia derived algorithmically from the Mushroom ring.

fold.title: Fold
fold.description: Draw a broad folded ribbon whose crease flips where the pitch turns: rising faces are lit, falling faces are shaded.
fold.livia: Mitoring's folded silver, read in Livistone as mitochondrial cristae.

open.title: Open
open.description: Leave an opening: a ring whose diameter is half the stroke length and whose scalloped edge follows the waver.
open.livia: Nanot's open cells and the openings that drain porous opal in Mycelium.

beads.title: Beads
beads.description: Place one bead per detected click; spacing follows the inter-click intervals and size follows click level.
beads.livia: Granular surface growth, as in the Brain ring; the rhythm of the clicks stays visible.

none.title: Continuous only
none.description: No command was recognized. The tip still grows with the measured continuous controls.
none.livia: The same outward gesture without a discrete effect.

mitoring-folds.title: Mitoring · grow, fold, open
mitoring-folds.description: Three gestures leave the amber. Holds and rests are part of the score: each rest lifts the brush to a new position on the stone.

mycelium-channels.title: Mycelium · branching drainage
mycelium-channels.description: Alternating rise and dip keys fork the brush into channels; bending the rises down halves their turning so the channels spread instead of knotting. Wavering tones open drainage holes at every tip; after a rest, a click train lays a beaded stem to a second root.

recorded-whistles.title: Recorded sounds through the same brush
recorded-whistles.description: Black keys play real OpenWhistle whistles and a DSWP sperm-whale coda. They are analyzed exactly like the synthesized keys; unrecognized whistles still draw through the continuous controls.

perturbations.feature: Pitch bend on a rising sweep
perturbations.expect: Same length and width; the extra half octave of rise adds 45° of turning.
Same total turning; the stroke becomes twice as long.
Same path; measured level widens the stroke.
A different recognized command: fold becomes an opening.
The rest lifts the brush; the branch starts from a new point on the stone.
Register is deliberately not mapped: recognition and stroke should be nearly identical.
